name: firebase-functions
description: Cloud Functions for the Tourist Map System. Phase 1A owns tenant provisioning (registerClient) — see docs/stages/STAGE_1A_TECHNICAL_PLAN.md §10, §15.

scripts.build:deps: pnpm --filter shared-types run build && pnpm --filter validation run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:deps && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.test: pnpm run build:deps && vitest run --passWithNoTests --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:provisioning: pnpm run build:deps && vitest run --config vitest.provisioning.config.ts
